chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
He said to me: If you do not catch up with the people before the Imam says the takbir for the rak'ah, then do not enter with them in that rak'ah.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the leader of the congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.لِلرَّكْعَةِ: for the rak'ah, the unit of salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُكَبِّرَ: to pronounce the takbir, marking a transition in the salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: When does a person miss a rak'ah in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling about joining congregational salat (prayer) at the point of ruku'. It indicates that if a person does not reach the congregation before the Imam pronounces the takbir for that rak'ah, he should not count himself as having joined that rak'ah.
